scope: In-app browser observations of the offline preview served by Vite at http://127.0.0.1:5173 (dev server started from src/LWBridge.UI-0.3.17 by the worker). Browser evidence, distinct from the synthetic hook tests and the differential against the original component. No native or gameplay action was invoked; every preview provider action is rejected with PREVIEW_NATIVE_ACTION_BLOCKED.
attribution: Worker-run observations. The project lead has not independently rerun them.

limits: Preview fixtures are deterministic offline data; a row showing Victory or Succeeded renders a recovered branch and is not the result of any game operation.
Several selection/tab checks used DOM click dispatch for speed; those are marked 'dom'. Real pointer/keyboard input was used where marked 'real'.
Screenshots are preview evidence, not original post-auth pixel comparison.

The preview scheduling/cancel/clear/share methods exist only for the dedicated map-actions-* and map-scheduled* fixture states so the recovered button predicates can be shown; in every other state and in production the buttons stay fenced.
